overview: GLoW proposes a dual-scale world memory framework for LLM agents to solve hard-exploration problems, maintaining a global trajectory frontier for principled value-decomposed state selection and a local multi-path advantage reflection mechanism for advantage-driven exploration, evaluated on the Jericho text-based game benchmark.

modules.name: Jericho Environment Interface
modules.description: Wraps the Jericho text-based game environment, providing APIs for step execution, observation retrieval, valid action extraction, score query, state snapshot, and state restoration, with support for deterministic action replay.

modules.name: State Archive Manager
modules.description: Maintains a dictionary-based archive of all discovered states paired with their achieved scores, supporting insertion with novelty/redundancy checks and retrieval for state selection.

modules.name: Trajectory Frontier Manager
modules.description: Implements a value-ranked sliding-window frontier of top-k highest-value trajectories, where value is defined as the maximum cumulative reward in an episode; supports frontier update via top-k selection upon new trajectory insertion.

modules.name: Global World Memory - Frontier Analysis (gLLM)
modules.description: Prompts an LLM to analyze the trajectory frontier and produce structured strategic analysis covering reached areas, checkpoints, bottlenecks, reward structure, and investigation goals, forming the textual basis for value decomposition.

modules.name: Global World Memory - Value Decomposition (Wglobal)
modules.description: Extracts from the frontier analysis a set of critical global states annotated with achieved value (v) and potential value (v'), implementing a semantic form of optimism under uncertainty analogous to UCB's exploitation-exploration decomposition.

modules.name: Value-Aligned State Selection (alignLLM)
modules.description: Given Wglobal and the state archive, prompts an LLM to score each archived state on how well it aligns with high-value patterns and bottleneck-adjacent potential, then selects the highest-scoring state as the next exploration starting point.

modules.name: State Restoration via Action Replay
modules.description: Replays the stored action sequence of a selected state's associated trajectory to deterministically return the environment to that state, enabling the Go-Explore paradigm of resuming exploration from promising states.

modules.name: Hybrid Action Space Handler
modules.description: Combines free-form LLM text generation with soft constraints from the environment's valid action list, providing valid actions as context to the LLM while still permitting novel action generation to balance action diversity and validity.

modules.name: Multi-Path Exploration Rollout
modules.description: From a selected state, sequentially samples n exploration trajectories using the LLM-based exploration policy, where each trajectory can leverage local world memory and previous trajectory outcomes from the same phase.

modules.name: Multi-Path Advantage Reflection (MAR)
modules.description: Prompts an LLM to compare multiple exploration trajectories from the same starting state against the frontier baseline, inferring semantic advantage signals at key state-action pairs (Wlocal) that capture progress signals invisible in sparse environmental rewards.

modules.name: Exploration Policy (π_explore)
modules.description: Defines the LLM agent's action selection during exploration, conditioning on the current observation, trajectory history, local world memory (Wlocal), prior local trajectories, and global frontier trajectories to produce advantage-driven actions.

modules.name: GLoW Main Loop Orchestrator
modules.description: Implements the full Go-Explore-style iterative cycle: state selection from archive using global world memory, multi-path exploration with local world memory, trajectory collection, frontier update, and archive update, within a fixed environment interaction budget.

modules.name: Evaluation and Benchmarking Suite
modules.description: Computes maximum achieved scores across games from the Jericho benchmark suite, supports multi-run aggregation with mean and standard deviation, and generates comparison tables against RL-based, MCTS-based, and LLM-based baselines.

modules.name: Ablation Study Framework
modules.description: Provides controlled ablation configurations for systematically removing or replacing: MAR (replaced with Reflexion), Wglobal (using raw frontier for selection), trajectory frontier F, or all components together to isolate individual and synergistic contributions.

modules.name: Hyperparameter Sensitivity and LLM Scaling Analysis
modules.description: Supports sweeping the exploration-per-state parameter (n) to study the global-local learning tradeoff, and swapping LLM backbones (e.g., nano, mini, full) to evaluate scaling behavior and the impact of model capability on world memory quality and overall performance.

modules.name: Contamination Check and Result Reporting
modules.description: Evaluates LLM prior knowledge of Jericho games via navigation question answering without gameplay context, and aggregates all experimental results into formatted tables, qualitative analysis outputs, and cost reports for API usage.
